June 18, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Next Financial Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 37.81% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Next Financial Group Inc bought 24,824 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 90,478 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.18 million, up from 65,654 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Next Financial Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $920.69B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $1.5224 during the last trading session, reaching $187.3176. About 694,277 shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
